# y12-t1-museum: unfinished starter

Read the task brief in the briefs folder and the common templates in the ZIP. All data is synthetic. display_shell.py runs a display-only Pygame window; student_game.py deliberately raises NotImplementedError until you implement the game. Read setup.md, common-requirements.md and common-marking-guide.md. Design and implement your own solution.

The pack supplies initial fixtures. Add normal, boundary, invalid and failure cases from the requirements. Public fixtures are not a secure marking key. Original content CC BY 4.0; code MIT.
